pages.title: https://www.travelmanitoba.com/directory/aspen-grove-campground/ | Aspen Grove Campground | Travel Manitoba
pages.lines:
Family owned and operated, we are located on the Trans-Canada Hwy#1 just 10 minutes between Oak Lake and Virden,MB and 40 minutes from Brandon. Featuring full service large sites, RV parking and tenting, Aspen Grove is a great place to relax and enjoy summer activities. Our amenities include hot showers, laundromat, C-Store, WIFI($) heated pool, playground, mini golf, horseshoes, giant checker board, hiking, volleyball & walking trails. Enjoy boating and fishing just 10 minutes from the lake. ​​
We are open from May to Sept our sites are private, shady they include fire pits, picnic tables. Nightly, weekly, monthly and Seasonal Sites available.
Fun for the whole family!
